rust_summary: particles for one player alone (`native_send_particles_to`), as vanilla's `ServerLevel.sendParticles(player, ...)`.
doc_summary: `native_send_particles_to(uuid, options, state, at, spread, speed, count, force)` (`host.send_particles_to`) shows particles to one player alone, within 32 blocks or 512 with `force`, as vanilla's `ServerLevel.sendParticles(player, ...)` and Bukkit's `Player.spawnParticle`; it leaves at the tick's end, so it works from any server hook. Bundles need "hooks": @API:send_particles_to@.
